what: small pre-runs (tools/prerun_reference.py) with the newborn means of Grok GF-1 and the frozen map's mean_ref
rule: the newborn mean of a trait: everyone born in the last full block of 30 birth years of the run (blocks [30 g, 30 g + 30) years from the start, g = years div 30 - 1; born div (30 * YEAR) = g; living, dead and emigrated), taken in ascending lineage key; A_i the additive value under the map this run freezes (d_ref = the measured mean doses of the living at the last census, here the measure at years * YEAR - 1); m = (sum of A_i folded from +0.0) / n, n as f64. Only the frozen map writes it, as mean_ref right after sigma_ref, for every trait; the next map of the iteration has d_ref and sigma_ref only (a rerun of a run reproduces its world, d_ref and sigma_ref bit for bit)
data: the pre-run documents of the template (prerun_reference.prerun_documents: the template of map 4 without the five disease loci, MC1R and HERC2 and without the Mendelian diseases) with data/calibration/demography.json; the frozen map is the template's map with the measured d_ref, sigma_ref and mean_ref (prerun_reference.frozen_documents)
fields: traits: living_mean (A under the run's map, the living), sigma (the measured sigma), newborn_mean (the rule), newborn_mean_with_run_d_ref (the same people under the run's own d_ref: what a wrong d_ref gives); newborn.persons: everyone counted, with A of core:longevity and core:growth under the frozen d_ref; *_bits are f64 as 16 hex digits big endian
